+# Exact carry execution and charged whole-period aggregation
+
+Recorded at 2026-09-27 02:15:34 UTC. Goal remains ACTIVE: develop mathematical tools toward QFT/Shor dequantization, report only qualified complexity gains. General efficient dequantization is not complete.
+
+## Immutable research and delivery
+
+- Repository: awdawmip/enterprise-math.
+- Scientific source: 8e2f54ce5581636b9169845a54f018c25d00b165.
+- Prefix: research_notes/directed_recovery/20260927_C6438C/qft_carry_execution/.
+- Read README.md, EXECUTION_NOTE.md and CONTINUE.md there.
+- All 59 source text files were fetched in full at that immutable commit. The 22 readable chunks reconstruct all five original gzip files exactly, including the superseded alias validation evidence.
+- Delivery receipt: e2d99491dcee7c0102d2def9341d2d5d6c3c5076, same prefix, DELIVERY_RECEIPT.json.
+- Authorized Drive backup folder: 1_pkz9U11tDbhWFTx7KX4_TngppfodZQC.
+- Complete ZIP: 1YzDgpP0Ns5Vk0m6Olx12aPPR4-uNguAI, 3,883,772 bytes, SHA-256 8a24a1d8fe83a89dd300d25e8b7d10de07c82eab6cc7fcca79cb527342fb0ae7.
+- The original ZIP was actually downloaded and all 65 ZIP members (64 indexed files plus index) verified. README and CONTINUE were also uploaded and downloaded byte-for-byte. No ephemeral bearer URL was persisted and no sharing permission was changed. Drive is backup; EM/GK remain authoritative.
+
+## Executed progress
+
+1. The exact two-carry displacement coefficient now runs through the admitted native words, signed observer and full-word exact carrier codec. It passes 134 complete D6 matrices, two complete D61 matrices/embeddings, ten assembled Gamma matrices, four masses and two positive-prefix next-bit conditionals; 16 invalid-input/binding negatives reject. 8,859 raw native-call receipts are retained. The noncommuting order negative has the same diagonal but the opposite residual (0,2) sign, so it would defeat a trace-only check.
+2. Complete typed baby/giant alias discovery passes 12 cases and 12 negatives, with 244 native receipts. Repeated baby residues and every signed output are retained. A mixed integer/string key collision in semantic verification was fixed before the final run; superseded evidence is explicitly retained. Semantic replay is not advertised as a strict external JSON type/resource sandbox; the consumer enforces integer displacements.
+3. Whole-period aggregation now runs. Eight complete matrices match complete alias sums, including residuals, with eight rejected controls and 2,568 native receipts. For four matched queries per input, aggregation phase-vector actions are 672 versus 1,266 on N21 and 480 versus 696 on N65. This is a gain over separate displacement contractions, not a proved gain over the old Gram/row/fair-suffix or factoring algorithms.
+4. A separate nine-matrix boundary run, 377 native receipts, confirms q=1 with a nonempty high block, s=i, and s>i including a unique negative displacement and an empty alias set. Actual typed first-return discovery found R=2 for N17/a4/depth3, R=8 for N17/a3/depth3, and R=24 for N97/a5/depth2.
+5. The symbolic whole-period lemma gives O(q(i-s)+s) matrix-transition groups for exact R=2^s q, s<=i. The current executable still pays O(R) full-cycle discovery and replays that certificate per query. The symbolic O(q+poly(log N)) small-odd-part discovery/address route is not yet implemented. All word lengths, arbitrary-width integers, index arithmetic and receipt costs remain charged.
+6. The collision-indicator cut has rank at least R in the stated odd-period regime. This limits exact local linear mask representations, not all weighted contractions, approximations, nonlocal methods or classical Shor simulators.
+
+The root matched carry-only comparisons used more native vector actions than old Gram (384/882/198/498 versus 120/168/72/120). Its 72 boundary scalar slots exclude terms, temporaries and receipts; it is not a total peak-memory claim. Period aggregation removes repeated alias work on the tested set but is not a general complexity breakthrough.
+
+## Scope and source correspondence
+
+All scientific executions use ACTUAL_TYPED_BRC_ONLY source correspondence. No ideal-QFT/float reference run or new physical-axis interpretation was introduced. D6 is only the previously admitted exact full61 word-boundary representation, not a discarded residual approximation. Status remains author/shared-context; no independent admission or accepted Result is claimed.
